svg.title: Filtered Row split learning curves: B100/B200/B300/FULL

cc:Work.dc:title: Filtered Row split learning curves: B100/B200/B300/FULL
cc:Work.dc:description: Filtered Row split learning curves, V1/V2 test RMSE means over five fixed seeds. B=100/200/300 counts train+validation labels; FULL x is mean actual eligible label count. Identical validation/test IDs and nested train prefixes. 8g/25g thresholds V1<=60,V2<=120; 40g V1<=150,V2<=200 mL. Zero-shot is an identical zero-target-training-label baseline at all contexts, shown as an annotation outside each panel; no baseline line is drawn. The four label-using methods use independent linear RMSE axes with visible numeric ticks and a uniform 8% margin (minimum .04 mL). No RMSE point labels, value tables, data jitter or offsets. Distinct colors, line styles and marker shapes make curves easier to read. Paper-style neural transfer is project implementation, not original-paper results. All new predictions froze before evaluation; previous results reused unchanged. Historically examined tests: descriptive learning curve.
